summary: Preinstall hook downloads Bun runtime to execute obfuscated bundled payload unrelated to advertised SDK
details: package.json declares a preinstall hook `node setup.mjs` that fires automatically on `npm install`. setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime from https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/ and then invokes it via `execFileSync(bun, ['math_init.js'])` to execute a 727 KB heavily-obfuscated JavaScript bundle shipped in the tarball. math_init.js contains a rotated string-array decoder (function `WV8StW` over a hex-literal constants table) and a `// @bun @bun-cjs` banner, and its purpose is not disclosed in the README or CHANGELOG. The dropper script itself uses hex-name identifier obfuscation (`_0x488df8`, `_0x52943e`,...). The payload's name (`math_init.js`) and content are inconsistent with the package's advertised OneReach Bots SDK purpose, and the bundle cannot be inspected statically without execution. Installing this package causes install-time execution of opaque, obfuscated code on the installer's host under a downloaded alternate runtime.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
